intro: Etawah lies on the plains of western Uttar Pradesh, with the Yamuna flowing past the town and the Chambal ravines close by. Summers here bring hot, dry winds, and winters are cold and often foggy. Outdoor equipment has to handle both extremes, year after year. FunPlay Systems makes playground equipment for schools, parks and housing colonies at our factory in Vasai, about 1,030 km away, and sends it to Etawah by road.

Galvanised steel and roto-moulded plastic are made for outdoor use through all of these seasons, which is why we build our frames and slides from them. Many Etawah enquiries come from schools with nursery and primary sections, so we often plan for the youngest children first. Share the age groups and the size of your site, and we will propose a layout with the safe play area marked around every piece.

sections.h: Choosing equipment for nursery and primary children
sections.html:
Children aged 2 to 5 need low heights, wide steps and handholds within reach. Look at 3 ft slides, spring riders, a toddler swing with a cradle seat and small crawl tunnels. Children from 6 to 10 can move on to 5 ft slides, climbers and see-saws. Keep the two groups in separate zones, each with its own safe play area, so the little ones are not knocked over by older children in a hurry.

See our 3 ft slides and toddler swing, or our page on playground equipment in Firozabad.

faq.q: What playground equipment suits children under five?
faq.a: Low slides, spring riders, toddler swings and crawl tunnels, which keep heights small and movements simple. We mark a separate safe play area for this group on the layout drawing.

faq.q: Does the equipment cope with Etawah's hot summers and cold winters?
faq.a: Yes. Our galvanised frames and roto-moulded parts are made for outdoor use in every season, with a 3-year warranty on pipes and moulded parts against manufacturing defects.

faq.q: How do I get a quote for a school in Etawah?
faq.a: Call +91 902 830 2266 or email sales@funplaysystems.com with your site size, photos and age groups. We will reply with suggested equipment and a layout drawing.

intro: Most playground enquiries from Faridabad come from housing societies, and many of the newer projects put the play area on a podium above basement parking. FunPlay Systems designs and manufactures playground equipment at our factory in Vasai, Maharashtra, about 1,100 km away, and sends it to the NCR by road. Our installation team or a dealer in North India then sets it up on your site.

A podium changes how equipment is fixed. You cannot dig into a waterproofed slab, so the equipment has to stand on its own base or be fixed in a way your structural consultant approves. We plan for this from the first drawing and share the base details with your architect. Faridabad's dusty summers and smoggy winters also leave a film on outdoor surfaces, so a regular wash keeps the equipment looking fresh.

sections.h: Play areas on a podium slab
sections.html:
On a podium we usually choose the self-standing installation method, where the equipment sits on its own base frame without breaking the waterproofing. Rubber flooring over the slab gives a cushioned surface and protects the membrane underneath. Check the drainage points before the layout is fixed, because a play deck over a drain outlet makes cleaning hard. Keep swings and spinning pieces well away from parapets and planters.

Compact Play Lands stations fit podium spaces well. For nearby sites, see playground equipment in Gurgaon and our outdoor gym equipment in Faridabad.

faq.q: Can playground equipment be installed on a podium without drilling the slab?
faq.a: Yes. We use the self-standing method, so the equipment rests on its own base frame. Your structural consultant should still review the layout before installation begins.

faq.q: Which surface do you suggest over a podium?
faq.a: Rubber flooring. It cushions falls, protects the waterproofing layer and lets water drain to the outlets. We can supply it along with the play equipment.

faq.q: Do you supply housing societies across Faridabad?
faq.a: Yes. We supply societies, schools and parks across Faridabad and the rest of the NCR, delivering from Vasai by road and installing with our team or a dealer.

intro: Farrukhabad sits on the Ganga in central Uttar Pradesh, a district town with its own schools, colleges and residential colonies. FunPlay Systems makes playground equipment for these buyers at our factory in Vasai, about 1,120 km away. We pack each order there and send it to Farrukhabad by road, where our installation team or a dealer in North India sets it up.

Buyers in smaller towns sometimes hesitate to contact a manufacturer so far away, unsure of what the process involves. It is simpler than it sounds. You share a few details and photos, we suggest equipment and draw the layout, and once you approve the quote we make, dispatch and install. Our sales team answers on +91 902 830 2266, Monday to Saturday, 9:00 AM to 6:30 PM.

sections.h: What to send us for a quote
sections.html:
• The length and width of the play area, even rough measurements paced out on foot.
  • Photos of the ground from each corner, showing trees, walls and drains.
  • The age group of the children and roughly how many will play at once.
  • Whether the ground is soil, grass, concrete or paving.

With these we can suggest equipment, choose between self-standing and grouted installation and mark the safe play area. For ideas before you write, browse our individual equipment or the Khel Khud range, inspired by Indian games.

faq.q: Do I need exact measurements to ask for a quote?
faq.a: Rough measurements and a few photos are enough to start. We can refine the layout drawing once you have exact figures from a site survey. A phone photo with a measuring tape laid on the ground also helps.

faq.q: Can you deliver to Farrukhabad from Vasai?
faq.a: Yes. We send the equipment by road and install it through our installation team or a dealer in North India, grouted or self-standing depending on the ground.

faq.q: What hours does your sales team work?
faq.a: Monday to Saturday, 9:00 AM to 6:30 PM. You can email sales@funplaysystems.com at any time, and we will reply during working hours.

intro: Fatehpur lies between Kanpur and Prayagraj, in the doab between the Ganga and the Yamuna. Its schools, colonies and public gardens deal with very hot summers, a short monsoon and cold winters. FunPlay Systems supplies playground equipment here from our factory in Vasai, Maharashtra, about 1,090 km away, delivered by road and installed by our own team or a local dealer.

One question we hear from first-time buyers is how much space a playground really needs. The answer depends less on the size of each piece than on the safe play area around it. A swing set that looks small on paper needs clear ground in front and behind, and a merry-go-round needs a ring of space on every side. Our layout drawings show this clearly, so you can see what fits before you order.

sections.html:
The safe play area is the zone around a piece of equipment that must stay free of benches, walls, trees and other equipment. Children move through it when they jump off a swing, land at the foot of a slide or step off a spinning platform. Overlapping these zones is a common layout mistake. Cover the zone with rubber flooring, keep walkways outside it and place seating for parents just beyond its edge.

Browse our merry-go-rounds and see-saws, or see playground equipment in Kanpur.

faq.q: How much space does a small playground need?
faq.a: It depends on the pieces you choose and their safe play areas. Send us the plot size and we will show on a layout drawing which pieces fit with proper clearance.

faq.q: Can benches go inside the safe play area?
faq.a: They should not. Benches, trees and walls belong outside it. We mark the boundary on the drawing so seating for parents can go just beyond the edge.

faq.q: Do you install playground equipment in Fatehpur?
faq.a: Yes. We deliver from Vasai by road and install through our own team or a dealer, using the self-standing or grouting method that suits your ground. Send us the plot size and photos to get started.

intro: Firozabad has made glass and bangles for generations, and in a town known for colour it makes sense to think about the colour of a play area early. FunPlay Systems designs and moulds its play equipment at our factory in Vasai, about 1,030 km away, and we offer more than 15 roto-moulded colour shades. Schools, colonies and parks in Firozabad can choose a combination that suits their building or theme.

Roto-moulded colour runs through the whole thickness of the plastic, so it does not peel or chip the way paint does. That matters in western Uttar Pradesh, where summer sun and dust wear down painted surfaces quickly. We deliver every order to Firozabad by road and install it with our own team or a dealer, on a self-standing base or grouted into the ground.

sections.html:
Pick two or three main colours and repeat them across the play area, rather than giving every piece a different shade. The space will look planned, and replacement parts are easier to match later. Lighter colours stay cooler in direct sun, which suits slides and decks. Brighter accents work well on panels and roofs, where children's hands do not rest for long. Our design team can also customise a structure to a school's theme.

Our Funplay Originals and Castle Crest ranges show what is possible. See also playground equipment in Agra.

faq.q: How many colours can we choose from?
faq.a: We offer more than 15 roto-moulded colour shades. Tell us your preferred colours or school theme, and we will suggest a combination for each piece on the layout.

faq.q: Will the colour of roto-moulded parts peel?
faq.a: The colour is part of the plastic itself, so it does not peel or chip like paint. Like any outdoor material, it can fade slowly over years in strong sun.

faq.q: Can you customise a design for our school?
faq.a: Yes. Our in-house design team can adapt structures to your requirements. Send us your ideas along with the site size and the age group of the children.

intro: Gandhidham was built to serve the port at Kandla, and its townships, schools and housing colonies sit on flat, dry Kutch ground close to the sea. Salt in the air and in the soil is the biggest challenge for outdoor equipment here. FunPlay Systems supplies playground equipment from our factory in Vasai, about 500 km away, and sends it to Kutch by road.

Bare steel rusts quickly in this setting, and painted metal starts to bubble within a few seasons. Galvanised pipe has a zinc coating that protects the steel, and roto-moulded plastic does not corrode. Summers are long and very hot, rainfall is low and dust storms are common, so we also plan shade and surfaces with care. Send us a site plan or photos and we will mark the safe play area on our layout.

sections.h: Dealing with saline soil and salt air
sections.html:
Saline ground attacks concrete and any steel buried in it. Where we grout equipment, the posts should sit in a well-made concrete base, finished so that water runs off rather than pooling around the post. Rinse the equipment with fresh water from time to time to wash off salt deposits, and check fixings and bolts as part of routine maintenance. Rubber flooring is easier to keep clean than sand in a dusty area.

See our Forestia range for township parks, our outdoor gym equipment in Gandhidham, or playground equipment in Jamnagar.

faq.q: Does playground equipment rust in Gandhidham's salty air?
faq.a: Galvanised steel and roto-moulded plastic resist salt air far better than painted steel. Rinsing the equipment with fresh water now and then stops salt deposits from building up.

faq.q: Do you supply port and industrial townships in Kutch?
faq.a: Yes. We supply townships, schools and housing colonies across Kutch and the rest of Gujarat, delivering from Vasai by road and installing with our team or a dealer.

faq.q: What maintenance does the equipment need near the coast?
faq.a: Rinse it with fresh water, tighten loose bolts and check springs and bearings regularly. Our after-sales team can share a simple maintenance routine at handover.

intro: Gandhinagar is a planned capital, laid out in numbered sectors with wide roads and a lot of tree cover. Many play areas here sit inside sector gardens, government housing and institutional campuses, with mature trees already in place. FunPlay Systems makes playground equipment for these sites at our factory in Vasai, Maharashtra, about 430 km away, and delivers it by road.

Trees give welcome shade in Gandhinagar's hot summers, but they also limit where equipment can go. Roots spread under the ground, branches overhang play zones and leaves block drains. We plan the layout around the trees you want to keep, using your photos and a rough site plan. Newer high-rise projects towards GIFT City bring a different kind of site, with podium gardens and compact spaces, and we plan those too.

sections.h: Working around trees in a sector garden
sections.html:
Keep posts and foundations clear of large roots, since cutting them can harm the tree and roots lift the ground over time. Check that no branch hangs low over a slide exit or a swing arc. Leaves and seed pods fall on decks and rubber flooring, so plan a sweeping routine, especially before the monsoon. A tree trunk should never sit inside a safe play area, however attractive it looks on the drawing.

Our Organic Play structures suit green settings. See also playground equipment in Ahmedabad.

faq.q: Can you plan a playground around existing trees?
faq.a: Yes. Mark the trees on your site photos or plan, and we will place the equipment so that trunks, roots and low branches stay outside each safe play area.

faq.q: Do you work with architects on campus projects?
faq.a: Yes. We share layout drawings and installation details with your architect or garden designer, so the play area fits into the wider design of the campus.

faq.q: How far is Gandhinagar from your factory?
faq.a: About 430 km by road from our factory in Vasai, Maharashtra. We send equipment by road and install it through our own team or a local dealer in Gujarat. That makes it one of the nearer state capitals we deliver to.

intro: Gangtok is built along steep ridges, and flat ground is the rarest thing on most sites here. Schools, hotels and residential buildings often have a terrace, a cut-out level or a small courtyard for a play area. FunPlay Systems manufactures playground equipment at our factory in Vasai, Maharashtra, about 1,830 km away, and sends it by road to Sikkim.

The last stretch of that road climbs through the hills, so we plan orders around how the parts will reach your site. Individual equipment and compact play stations are easier to carry up and assemble than one large tower. Gangtok is cool for much of the year, very wet in the monsoon and cold in winter. Our galvanised and roto-moulded materials are made for outdoor use in all of these. Send us photos of your terrace or courtyard and its measurements.

sections.h: Fitting a play area onto a hillside plot
sections.html:
Work with the flat level you have rather than forcing equipment onto a slope. A terrace too small for a play station may still take a swing, a spring rider and a short slide. Check the edges, since a play area next to a drop needs a railing well outside the safe play area. Heavy rain runs fast down hill sites, so the base must drain away from walls and steps. On a concrete terrace, self-standing installation avoids drilling into the slab.

See our spring riders and 3 ft slides, or our page on playground equipment in Sikkim.

faq.q: Can you install playground equipment on a hillside terrace in Gangtok?
faq.a: Yes, if the terrace is level and large enough for the safe play area. We usually suggest self-standing installation on concrete terraces and plan the drainage carefully.

faq.q: Will the equipment cope with Gangtok's rain and cold?
faq.a: Our galvanised frames and roto-moulded parts are built for outdoor use in wet and cold weather. Springs and bearings should be checked after each monsoon.

faq.q: Can large play structures be taken up to Gangtok?
faq.a: We plan the order around access to your site. For narrow roads and steep approaches, individual pieces and compact play stations are usually the practical choice.

intro: Gaya and nearby Bodh Gaya draw pilgrims from across India and the world, and the area has monasteries, residential schools and guest houses as well as the usual town schools and colonies. FunPlay Systems supplies playground equipment for all of these from our factory in Vasai, about 1,380 km away. We send each order to Bihar by road and install it with our team or a dealer.

Residential schools and monastery campuses use their play areas differently from a day school. Children are on site all day, every day, including weekends and holidays. The equipment gets many more hours of use, so sturdy frames, few loose parts and a clear maintenance routine matter most. Gaya's summers are also fiercely hot, so plan shade over the play area and keep outdoor play to the cooler hours.

sections.h: Equipment for residential schools and campuses
sections.html:
For heavy daily use, choose pieces built from galvanised pipe and roto-moulded parts, which carry our 3-year warranty against manufacturing defects. Springs, bearings and spare parts carry 1 year, so keep a simple monthly check of swing hangers, spring riders and merry-go-round bearings. Spread the activities around so that children do not crowd one slide. A mix of climbers, swings and a multi play station keeps more children busy at once.

See our climbers and the NexLev series, or playground equipment in Patna.

faq.q: What equipment holds up best in a residential school?
faq.a: Galvanised frames and roto-moulded parts with few loose components. Plan enough pieces to spread the children out, and follow a regular check of moving parts such as hangers and bearings.

faq.q: Can monasteries and guest houses in Bodh Gaya order from you?
faq.a: Yes. Any campus, school or guest house in Gaya and Bodh Gaya can order from us. We deliver from Vasai by road and install through our team or a dealer.

faq.q: How should we plan for Gaya's summer heat?
faq.a: Place slides and decks in shade where you can, and use rubber flooring instead of sand, which gets very hot. Schools can also move outdoor play to the early morning in May and June.

intro: Ghaziabad has filled with high-rise housing, from Indirapuram and Vaishali to Raj Nagar Extension and Crossings Republik. Most of our enquiries here come from builders who need a play area ready before handover and from residents' associations upgrading one afterwards. FunPlay Systems makes the equipment at our factory in Vasai, about 1,130 km away, and sends it to the NCR by road.

The two buyers want different things. A builder needs a play area that photographs well, fits the approved site plan and is ready for possession. A residents' association wants equipment that will last, suits the children who actually live there and is easy to maintain. We work with both, and the layout drawing is where those needs get settled before anything is made.

sections.h: For builders handing over a project
sections.html:
Bring us in when the garden and site plan is being finalised, before the paving is done. We can suggest a play station that matches the project's look, mark foundation points for the civil contractor and plan rubber flooring at the same time. Share the age mix you expect, since a project of family flats needs more junior equipment than one of smaller units. After handover, the residents' association can deal with our after-sales team directly.

Builders often start with our Play Lands or NexLev structures. See also our page for builders and playground equipment in Noida.

faq.q: When should a builder contact you about the playground?
faq.a: While the garden and site plan is being finalised. That way foundation points and flooring are planned with the civil work, instead of breaking new paving later.

faq.q: Can a residents' association add equipment to an existing play area?
faq.a: Yes. Send us photos and measurements of the current area. We will suggest pieces that fit and redraw the layout with safe play areas for the old and new equipment.

faq.q: Who do residents contact for after-sales service?
faq.a: Our after-sales team on +91 738 530 0921 or aftersales@funplaysystems.com. The warranty covers manufacturing defects when the equipment is installed and maintained as per our instructions.

intro: Giridih is a district town on the Chota Nagpur plateau, and its district includes Parasnath hill, one of the most important Jain pilgrimage sites. Schools, colonies and the dharamshalas along the pilgrimage route all have use for a well-planned play area. FunPlay Systems makes every piece at our factory in Vasai, Maharashtra, about 1,480 km away, and sends it to Jharkhand by road.

Buyers far from our factory often want to know what happens if something goes wrong after installation. That is a fair question, and the answer lies in our warranty and after-sales support, which we explain before you order. Our installation team or a dealer in eastern India carries out the installation, using the self-standing or grouting method suited to your ground. You receive the maintenance notes at the same time.

sections.html:
• Galvanised pipes, roto-moulded parts, composite laminates and play rope: 3 years.
  • Springs, bearings and spare parts: 1 year.

The warranty covers manufacturing defects when the equipment is installed and maintained as per our instructions. Keep the maintenance notes we share, check bolts and moving parts regularly, and call our after-sales team on +91 738 530 0921 if anything looks wrong. On the plateau, monsoon rain and summer heat both test fixings, so a check after each season helps.

For the full range, see CoreCraft, or playground equipment in Dhanbad.

faq.q: How long is the warranty on playground equipment?
faq.a: Our frames, moulded parts, laminates and play ropes carry 3 years against manufacturing defects. Springs, bearings and spare parts carry 1 year.

faq.q: Do you deliver to Giridih?
faq.a: Yes. Equipment is made in Vasai and sent to Giridih by road. Our installation team or a dealer then installs it according to the approved layout drawing. Send us photos of the site to begin.

faq.q: Can a dharamshala or trust order playground equipment?
faq.a: Yes. Any trust, school or society can order from us. Share the space available and the age group of the children, and we will suggest equipment and a layout.

intro: Gopalpur is a beach town on the Odisha coast, near Berhampur, with hotels and resorts facing the Bay of Bengal. A play area here has to live with salt air, sea breeze and the cyclones that sometimes come in from the bay. FunPlay Systems supplies playground equipment to hotels, resorts, schools and colonies along this coast from our factory in Vasai, about 1,260 km away.

For a beach property, the play area is often one of the first things families notice. We help you choose a piece that suits the setting and place it where parents can sit nearby, away from the pool and the beach path. Galvanised frames and roto-moulded plastic are the right materials so close to the sea. We send everything by road and install it with our own team or a dealer in eastern India.

sections.h: Looking after equipment near the sea
sections.html:
Salt and sand are hard on moving parts. Rinse the equipment with fresh water regularly, especially swing hangers, spring riders and merry-go-round bearings. Sand blown onto slides acts like sandpaper, so brush it off before guests use them. Before the cyclone season, check that every bolt is tight and that grouted bases are sound. Rubber flooring keeps the play area firmer and cleaner than open sand.

Resorts often choose themed pieces from Kagzi, inspired by paper folding, or Clown Capade. See also playground equipment in Berhampur.

faq.q: Which play equipment suits a beach resort in Gopalpur?
faq.a: Galvanised steel and roto-moulded pieces in a theme that fits the setting, such as our Kagzi paper boat and paper fish designs. Place them in sight of guest seating and away from the pool.

faq.q: How should we prepare play equipment for a cyclone?
faq.a: Check that every bolt is tight and the foundations are sound before the season. After a storm, inspect the equipment for damage before children use it again.

faq.q: Do you deliver to the Odisha coast?
faq.a: Yes. We send orders from Vasai to Gopalpur and other coastal towns in Odisha by road, and install them through our team or a dealer.
